tracks.title: Theme
tracks.cast: Acoustic piano opening to bright wood/flute band
tracks.decision: The miniature opening leads to bright wood and wind. Keep r2 for the more readable pipe and guitar attack. A quieter opening trial lost definition before the band.

tracks.title: Simian Segue
tracks.cast: Djafe / Latin pan-flute conversation
tracks.decision: Separate the Djafe and pan-flute chairs by attack and tone. The suspected late missing attack fell in a space between wind entries, and the more subdued answer is intentional.

tracks.title: DK Island Swing
tracks.cast: Percussion party with winds and upright bass
tracks.decision: Start on the corrected percussion pocket and let upright and winds enter in the game order. The flagged later flutter belongs to the recorded wood register and source motion.

tracks.title: Cranky's Theme
tracks.cast: Dry acoustic piano, woody bass, sparse skin taps
tracks.decision: Keep the dry comic timing and audible guitar. The short low answer overlaps slightly and the line stays clear.

tracks.title: Cave Dweller Concert
tracks.cast: Hollow udu, wood, breathy flute and quiet metal
tracks.decision: Use hollow skin, wood, flute and quiet metal for the cave. The damped reprise bridge improved the handoff while retaining the low space.

tracks.title: Bonus Room Blitz
tracks.cast: Bright balafon, acoustic guitar, dancing small percussion
tracks.decision: Restore the rising nylon-string reply beside the bright wooden rhythm. Its measured pitch-wheel behavior carries the original slide rather than an isolated pluck.

tracks.title: Aquatic Ambiance
tracks.cast: Steel pan / soft handpan, bright wood answer
tracks.decision: Use warm steel and handpan as distinct chairs. The calibrated steel realizes 299 source attacks over 27 tested keys. R7 softens the late wooden reply at the identified peaks.

tracks.title: Candy's Love Song
tracks.cast: Acoustic piano, nylon guitar and softly articulated wind
tracks.decision: Carry the melody through acoustic piano, nylon guitar and wind. R3 gives the last low piano response more room, with a small local conga trim and a longer release.

tracks.title: Bad Boss Boogie
tracks.cast: Low wood ostinato, upright bass, hand drums and fierce wind
tracks.decision: Keep the low wooden motor, upright, hand drums and bold wind. R2 shapes kit and scrape transients, supporting the repeated nylon figure.

tracks.title: Mine Cart Madness
tracks.cast: Dry mallet motor, bass, guitar and interlocking skin taps
tracks.decision: Keep the dry mallet motion and guitar answers. R2 reduces stacked wood peaks and percussion low mids while preserving the handoff into the later phrase.

tracks.title: Life in the Mines
tracks.cast: Pan flute and Djafe duet, restrained cave metal
tracks.decision: Keep the pan flute and Djafe duet. The low strings restore the register anchor. Recorded breaths and two attack colors separate the players.

tracks.title: Voices of the Temple
tracks.cast: Low winds, struck wood, hand percussion and spare piano
tracks.decision: Ground the wood in a clearer low chair. Five game percussion strikes absent from the guide remain in the performance.

tracks.title: Forest Frenzy
tracks.cast: Wind call, wooden upper ostinato, low strings, piano responses and hand percussion
tracks.decision: Use the selected wooden upper figure over low strings and piano. R7 lifts only the quiet opening and finishes its contour at 5.8 seconds. The genuine bass-led alternate remains a useful color study.

tracks.title: Treetop Rock
tracks.cast: Brighter wood/flute alternation and tightly interlocked drums
tracks.decision: Let wood and flute exchange the bright melody. R3 adds a short G answer after the second complete source statement to make the cadence deliberate.

tracks.title: Funky's Fugue
tracks.cast: Soul Bass foreground with acoustic guitar and real drums
tracks.decision: Keep the approved guitar sound and Soul Bass foreground. The string-only bass state supports the band. A short recorded guiro and light snare realize the original late punctuation in place of marimba.

tracks.title: Misty Menace
tracks.cast: Sparse handpan, low wood, breath tones and resonant skin
tracks.decision: Retain the sparse handpan, wood and dark breath. A recorded conga return fills the original opening gates. The follow-up sequence listen confirmed its quiet decay.

tracks.title: Northern Hemispheres
tracks.cast: Airy flute, gentle guitar harmonics, piano and quiet metal
tracks.decision: Shape the scrape and high wood transient while leaving the airy arrangement spacious. The longer active phrases stay understated.

tracks.title: Ice Cave Chant
tracks.cast: Clear high flute, bright wood and measured low drums
tracks.decision: Keep the clear flute and original wood role. A more aggressive pipe treatment lost air in comparison, so r2 carries the upper melody.

tracks.title: Fear Factory
tracks.cast: Balafon motor, hand drums, acoustic piano and wind call
tracks.decision: Keep the balafon motor, hand drums, piano and wind. The original register trace supports the stepped mechanisms. R7 eases the first transient and returns to full gain by 5.4 seconds.

tracks.title: Gang-Plank Galleon
tracks.cast: Acoustic guitar/wood opening to a fierce flute/percussion band
tracks.decision: Keep the quiet shanty shape and the source band arrival around 30.46 seconds. The guitar, wood and wind grow into the full percussion section.

tracks.title: K. Rool's Cacophony
tracks.cast: Sparse acoustic piano, low wind and patient final cadence
tracks.decision: Keep the sparse final gesture and its quiet decay. This is the selected master for both Cacophony and the separately catalogued Game Over presentation.

tracks.title: The Credits Concerto
tracks.cast: Returning acoustic band colors with piano-led closing statement
tracks.decision: Keep the earlier warm ensemble and final piano response. Two alternate release treatments gave no convincing improvement in the comparisons.

tracks.title: Fanfare
tracks.cast: Bright acoustic brass-like wind and struck wood gesture
tracks.decision: Use the r1 reward timbre and cadence at a uniform 0.85 dB lower level. The louder reference and a more heavily treated EQ alternate were useful comparisons.

tracks.title: Level Goal
tracks.cast: Compact wood/flute/piano cadence
tracks.decision: Keep the compact wood, flute and piano gesture. R2 restores lower-mid body and the actual short ending remains legible among the fuller rewards.

tracks.title: Bonus Win
tracks.cast: Warm bright wood and hand drum success cadence
tracks.decision: Keep the warmer wooden success gesture and hand-drum answer. The ordered rewards remain distinct at a shared playback level.

tracks.title: Bonus Lose
tracks.cast: Muted acoustic punctuation and descending response
tracks.decision: Keep the muted punctuation and descending reply. The archived and direct game endings agree, and the separate loss cadence decays cleanly.

tracks.title: Lost Life
tracks.cast: Small wood/wind fall and dry low punctuation
tracks.decision: Keep the small falling wood and wind figure. The quieter life-loss punctuation clears naturally before the next cue.

tracks.title: Bonus Room Opened!
tracks.cast: Short flute/wood entrance signal
tracks.decision: Use all 13 live lead attacks and the first live echo delay. The complete echo is retained from the isolated original state for standalone listening.

tracks.title: Extra Life Balloon
tracks.cast: Bright short pan/wood rising gesture
tracks.decision: Use all 24 live pickup pitches and attack times on recorded handpan. The complete standalone recheck and both decoders confirmed the final decay.
